svg.title: Where my pull requests landed
svg.desc: An isometric city with one building per repository and one floor per merged pull request, grouped into company districts. Microsoft: onnxscript 6, kiota 5, azure-sdk-for-js 1, mssql-python 1, playwright 1, typespec 1, vscode-cmake-tools 1; Meta: lexical 10, stylex 2; Cloudflare: workers-sdk 2; Apple: coremltools 1; AWS: mcp 1; Tesla: fixed-containers 1.
